# Transformation, Loading, and ETL Pipelines {#sec-etl-transform-cap}

::: {.callout-note}
Continuation of the previous chapter. Assumes you have the DataFrame `df` loaded from DBFS.
:::

## 1. Transformation (Transform) {#sec-etl-transform}

### 1.1 Column Functions (`pyspark.sql.functions`)

```python
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    col, lit, when, coalesce,
    to_timestamp, date_format, hour, dayofweek, month,
    regexp_replace, trim, upper, lower,
    round as spark_round, abs as spark_abs,
    log1p, sqrt,
    sum as spark_sum, avg, count, countDistinct,
    lag, lead, rank, dense_rank,
    window
)
```

### 1.2 Data Cleaning at Scale

```python
# Filter out invalid trip records (negative distances, negative fares, etc.)
df_clean = (df
    .filter(col("trip_distance") > 0)
    .filter(col("fare_amount")   > 0)
    .filter(col("total_amount")  > 0)
    .filter(col("passenger_count").between(1, 6))
    # Remove extreme outliers (99.9th percentile ≈ $120 USD total fare)
    .filter(col("total_amount") < 500)
)

# Impute missing values with default defaults
df_clean = df_clean.fillna({
    "passenger_count": 1,
    "trip_distance":   0.0,
})

# Feature engineering and derived columns
df_feat = (df_clean
    .withColumn("pickup_hour",    hour("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
    .withColumn("day_of_week",    dayofweek("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
    .withColumn("month",          month("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
    .withColumn("duration_min",
        (col("tpep_dropoff_datetime").cast("long") -
         col("tpep_pickup_datetime").cast("long")) / 60)
    .withColumn("fare_per_km",
        when(col("trip_distance") > 0,
             spark_round(col("fare_amount") / col("trip_distance"), 2))
        .otherwise(None))
    .withColumn("tip_percentage",
        spark_round(col("tip_amount") / col("fare_amount") * 100, 1))
)
```

### 1.3 Aggregations and Window Functions

```python
from pyspark.sql import Window

# Simple aggregation: hourly revenue totals
hourly_revenue = (df_feat
    .groupBy("pickup_hour")
    .agg(
        count("*").alias("trip_count"),
        avg("total_amount").alias("avg_ticket"),
        spark_sum("total_amount").alias("total_revenue")
    )
    .orderBy("pickup_hour")
)
hourly_revenue.show(24)

# Window function: rank pickup zones by daily revenue
wspec = Window.partitionBy("month","day_of_week").orderBy(col("total_revenue").desc())

ranking = (df_feat
    .groupBy("month","day_of_week","PULocationID")
    .agg(spark_sum("total_amount").alias("total_revenue"))
    .withColumn("rank", dense_rank().over(wspec))
    .filter(col("rank") <= 5)
    .orderBy("month","day_of_week","rank")
)
ranking.show(20)
```

### 1.4 Joins at Scale

```python
# Read small lookup table (fits entirely in memory → broadcast join)
from pyspark.sql.functions import broadcast

zones = spark.read.csv("data/taxi_zone_lookup.csv",
                       header=True, inferSchema=True)

# Broadcast join: Spark distributes small table to all executor nodes
df_with_zone = df_feat.join(
    broadcast(zones),
    df_feat.PULocationID == zones.LocationID,
    "left"
)

# For large tables: sort-merge join (Spark's default strategy)
df_large_join = df_feat.join(other_large_table, on="join_key", how="inner")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
**Avoid Cartesian Products.** Unconditioned joins on large DataFrames create `N×M` rows and exhaust cluster memory. Spark will raise an error unless `.crossJoin()` is explicitly invoked.
:::

## 2. SQL Transformations with Spark {#sec-spark-sql}

Spark SQL allows running standard ANSI SQL queries over DataFrames:

```python
# Register DataFrame as a temporary view
df_feat.createOrReplaceTempView("trips")

# SQL query execution — identical to queries written in BigQuery or Snowflake
result = spark.sql("""
    SELECT
        pickup_hour,
        day_of_week,
        COUNT(*)                           AS trip_count,
        ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2)        AS avg_ticket,
        ROUND(AVG(tip_percentage), 1)      AS avg_tip_pct,
        ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 0)        AS total_revenue
    FROM trips
    WHERE total_amount BETWEEN 2.5 AND 200
    GROUP BY pickup_hour, day_of_week
    ORDER BY pickup_hour, day_of_week
""")
result.show(48)
```

::: {.callout-tip}
If you already know ANSI SQL, you can begin querying with Spark SQL right away. DataFrame methods and SQL queries compile down to identical Catalyst physical plans.
:::

## 3. Loading (Load) {#sec-etl-load}

### 3.1 Writing to Parquet (Standard Lakehouse Format)

```python
# Basic overwrite write
df_feat.write.mode("overwrite").parquet("output/clean_trips/")

# Partitioned write — essential for query partition pruning
df_feat.write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .partitionBy("month", "day_of_week")\
    .parquet("output/trips_by_date/")

# Control number of output files on disk
df_feat.coalesce(8).write.mode("overwrite").parquet("output/trips_8files/")
```

### 3.2 Delta Lake — The Lakehouse Format with ACID

```python
from delta import configure_spark_with_delta_pip, DeltaTable

spark = configure_spark_with_delta_pip(
    SparkSession.builder.appName("ETL-Delta")
    .config("spark.sql.extensions", "io.delta.sql.DeltaSparkSessionExtension")
    .config("spark.sql.catalog.spark_catalog",
            "org.apache.spark.sql.delta.catalog.DeltaCatalog")
).getOrCreate()

# Initial table write
df_feat.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save("output/delta/trips/")

# Upsert (MERGE) — core pattern for incremental data loading
delta_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "output/delta/trips/")

new_data = spark.read.parquet("data/yellow_tripdata_2023-02.parquet")

(delta_table.alias("target")
    .merge(new_data.alias("source"),
           "target.VendorID = source.VendorID AND "
           "target.tpep_pickup_datetime = source.tpep_pickup_datetime")
    .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
    .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
    .execute())

# Time Travel — Query past versions of the table
df_v0 = spark.read.format("delta").option("versionAsOf", 0)\
             .load("output/delta/trips/")
```

### 3.3 Writing to a Relational Database (JDBC)

```python
(df_feat.write
    .format("jdbc")
    .option("url",      "jdbc:postgresql://dw-host:5432/datawarehouse")
    .option("dbtable",  "facts.taxi_trips")
    .option("user",     "etl_user")
    .option("password", "secret")
    .option("batchsize", 10000)     # rows per batch INSERT
    .option("numPartitions", 8)     # parallel connections
    .mode("append")
    .save())
```

## 4. End-to-End ETL Pipeline {#sec-etl-pipeline}

Connecting Extract, Transform, and Load into a reusable pipeline function:

```python
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, DataFrame
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    col, hour, dayofweek, month, when,
    spark_round as _round
)
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
log = logging.getLogger("ETL-Taxi")


def extract(spark: SparkSession, path: str) -> DataFrame:
    log.info(f"Extracting raw data from {path}")
    return spark.read.parquet(path)


def transform(df: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    log.info("Transforming datasets...")
    return (df
        .filter(col("trip_distance") > 0)
        .filter(col("fare_amount").between(2.5, 500))
        .filter(col("passenger_count").between(1, 6))
        .fillna({"passenger_count": 1})
        .withColumn("pickup_hour", hour("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
        .withColumn("day_of_week", dayofweek("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
        .withColumn("month",       month("tpep_pickup_datetime"))
        .withColumn("duration_min",
            (col("tpep_dropoff_datetime").cast("long") -
             col("tpep_pickup_datetime").cast("long")) / 60)
        .filter(col("duration_min").between(1, 180))
        .withColumn("tip_percentage",
            when(col("fare_amount") > 0,
                 _round(col("tip_amount")/col("fare_amount")*100, 1))
            .otherwise(0.0))
    )


def load(df: DataFrame, output_path: str) -> None:
    log.info(f"Loading cleaned output into {output_path}")
    (df.write
        .mode("overwrite")
        .partitionBy("month", "day_of_week")
        .parquet(output_path))
    log.info("ETL pipeline execution complete!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    spark = (SparkSession.builder
        .appName("ETL-NYC-Taxi")
        .master("local[*]")
        .config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "16")
        .getOrCreate())

    raw   = extract(spark, "data/yellow_tripdata_2023-01.parquet")
    clean = transform(raw)
    load(clean, "output/taxi_etl/")

    spark.stop()
```

```{=html}
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Interactive ETL Pipeline Simulation
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="etl-pipeline-wrap" style="margin:2rem 0">
  <div style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:.8rem">
    <button onclick="etlPipe.run()" id="etl-btn-run"
      style="padding:.45rem 1.4rem;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:#3b82f6;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600">
      ▶ Run Pipeline
    </button>
    <button onclick="etlPipe.reset()"
      style="padding:.45rem 1.4rem;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:#475569;color:#fff;cursor:pointer">
      ↺ Reset
    </button>
  </div>
  <canvas id="etl-cv" width="700" height="200"
    style="width:100%;border-radius:10px;background:#0f172a;display:block"></canvas>
  <div id="etl-log"
    style="margin-top:.6rem;background:#1e293b;border-radius:8px;padding:.8rem 1rem;
           font-family:monospace;font-size:.82rem;color:#94a3b8;min-height:4rem;
           max-height:8rem;overflow-y:auto"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  const cv = document.getElementById('etl-cv');
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  const DPR = window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const W=700, H=200;
  cv.width=W*DPR; cv.height=H*DPR; cv.style.width=W+'px'; cv.style.height=H+'px';
  ctx.scale(DPR,DPR);

  const stages = [
    { label:'EXTRACT', sub:'Parquet / CSV / JDBC', color:'#0ea5e9',
      rows:3200000, detail:'3,200,000 rows read · 16 partitions' },
    { label:'FILTER', sub:'dist>0, fare∈[2.5,500]', color:'#f59e0b',
      rows:3050000, detail:'150,000 rows filtered (outliers, nulls)' },
    { label:'FEATURE ENG.', sub:'hour, day, duration, tip%', color:'#a855f7',
      rows:3050000, detail:'6 derived columns appended' },
    { label:'LOAD', sub:'Partitioned Parquet (month×day)', color:'#10b981',
      rows:3050000, detail:'Written to output/taxi_etl/ · 56 files' },
  ];

  const logEl = document.getElementById('etl-log');
  let running = false;

  function drawStage(i, progress, done){
    const x = 30 + i*(160+10);
    const y = 30, bw=155, bh=120;

    if(done){
      ctx.shadowColor = stages[i].color;
      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = done ? stages[i].color : '#1e293b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, bw, bh, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    if(progress > 0 && progress < 1){
      ctx.fillStyle = stages[i].color + '55';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(x, y+bh*(1-progress), bw, bh*progress, 10);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = stages[i].color;
    ctx.lineWidth = done ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, bw, bh, 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = done ? '#fff' : '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(stages[i].label, x+bw/2, y+38);
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = done ? '#e2e8f0' : '#475569';
    const words = stages[i].sub.split(' ');
    let line='', lineY=y+58;
    words.forEach(w=>{
      if((line+w).length > 18){ ctx.fillText(line,x+bw/2,lineY); line=w+' '; lineY+=14; }
      else line+=w+' ';
    });
    ctx.fillText(line,x+bw/2,lineY);

    if(done){
      ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.fillText(stages[i].rows.toLocaleString(), x+bw/2, y+108);
    }

    if(i < stages.length-1){
      const ax = x+bw+2, ay=y+bh/2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = done ? stages[i].color : '#334155';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.setLineDash(done?[]:[4,4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ax,ay); ctx.lineTo(ax+7,ay);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      if(done){
        ctx.fillStyle=stages[i].color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ax+7,ay);
        ctx.lineTo(ax+2,ay-5);
        ctx.lineTo(ax+2,ay+5);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function render(completed, activeIdx, progress){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    stages.forEach((_,i)=>{
      const done = i < completed || (i===activeIdx&&progress>=1);
      const prog = i===activeIdx ? progress : (done?1:0);
      drawStage(i, prog, done);
    });
  }

  function log(msg){ logEl.innerHTML += `<div>→ ${msg}</div>`; logEl.scrollTop=9999; }

  function run(){
    if(running) return;
    running=true;
    document.getElementById('etl-btn-run').disabled=true;
    let stageIdx=0;
    function nextStage(){
      if(stageIdx>=stages.length){ running=false; log('✅ ETL Completed.'); return; }
      log(`[${stages[stageIdx].label}] ${stages[stageIdx].detail}`);
      let p=0;
      const iv = setInterval(()=>{
        p+=0.04;
        render(stageIdx, stageIdx, Math.min(p,1));
        if(p>=1){ clearInterval(iv); stageIdx++; setTimeout(nextStage,300); }
      },30);
    }
    nextStage();
  }

  function reset(){
    running=false;
    logEl.innerHTML='';
    document.getElementById('etl-btn-run').disabled=false;
    render(0,-1,0);
  }

  window.etlPipe = {run,reset};
  reset();
})();
</script>
```
